name: @toktokdata.live/mcp

tools.name: rankings_official
tools.description: One official TikTok LIVE leaderboard for one region, as TikTok publishes it: rank, score, creator, live status, movement and a 7-period sparkline. Check `publishable` and `coverage` before trusting entries; rows beyond the plan's unmask tier come back `masked: true` without identity. Needs API key scope `rank:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

board.description: Board key: `daily`, `hourly`, `popular_live`, `gaming_daily`, `gaming_weekly`, `shopping_daily`, `shopping_weekly` (shopping boards need the `shop:read` scope), or a league board `league_a1` … `league_d5`.

period.description: `current` is the running period (default), `history` the last completed one.

tools.name: rankings_regions
tools.description: Regions that currently have observed boards, with a display label, coverage and the boards offered. Needs API key scope `rank:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: rankings_history
tools.description: Completed periods of one board, newest first, within the plan's history window (one page; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next). Needs API key scope `rank:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

board.description: Board key: `daily`, `hourly`, `popular_live`, `gaming_daily`, `gaming_weekly`, `shopping_daily`, `shopping_weekly` (shopping boards need the `shop:read` scope), or a league board `league_a1` … `league_d5`.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `nextCursor` of the previous page.

tools.name: rankings_day_bars
tools.description: For each board day of the last `days` days: how many creators the board listed, the lowest score on it (the bar to make the board) and the top score. `daily` and the league boards only. Needs API key scope `rank:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: creators_search
tools.description: Stored creators whose handle or display name contains `q` (case-insensitive), most-followed first. An empty `q` browses the stored set. Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

q.description: Handle (with or without `@`) or part of the display name.

tools.name: creators_get
tools.description: The public profile of a creator (followers, likes, videos, bio, verification, region) and its recent counter history. A creator not stored yet is looked up on TikTok first. Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). May wait up to 40 s while toktokdata.live collects fresh data; if it is still collecting, the tool says when to retry. Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle without `@` (e.g. `linh.live`) or numeric TikTok user id.

tools.name: creators_analysis
tools.description: Engagement report computed from the creator's stored videos: totals, medians, posting cadence, plus up to five coded findings (`read`) and what the report cannot cover (`limits`). Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle without `@` (e.g. `linh.live`) or numeric TikTok user id.

tools.name: creators_changes
tools.description: Handle, name, bio and verification changes observed over time, newest first. Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle without `@` (e.g. `linh.live`) or numeric TikTok user id.

tools.name: creators_followers
tools.description: One page of the creator's stored followers (pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page). Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). May wait up to 40 s while toktokdata.live collects fresh data; if it is still collecting, the tool says when to retry. Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle without `@` (e.g. `linh.live`) or numeric TikTok user id.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `nextCursor` of the previous page.

tools.name: creators_following
tools.description: One page of the accounts the creator follows (stored follow graph). Private accounts return `isPrivate: true` and no entries. Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). May wait up to 40 s while toktokdata.live collects fresh data; if it is still collecting, the tool says when to retry. Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle without `@` (e.g. `linh.live`) or numeric TikTok user id.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `nextCursor` of the previous page.

tools.name: creators_gifters
tools.description: Top gifters of the creator's LIVE rooms over the last 7 or 30 days, by diamonds: gift count, sessions, last gift. Coverage is always partial (recorded sessions only). Needs the Pro plan or above. Needs API key scope `gifter:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle without `@` (e.g. `linh.live`) or numeric TikTok user id.

tools.name: creators_insights
tools.description: Handle history, daily diamonds of the last 30 days, daily league snapshots and the creator's LIVE room. Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle without `@` (e.g. `linh.live`) or numeric TikTok user id.

tools.name: creators_videos
tools.description: Videos stored for the creator, newest first, with play, like and comment counts. Needs API key scope `content:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle without `@` (e.g. `linh.live`) or numeric TikTok user id.

tools.name: agencies_list
tools.description: TikTok LIVE agencies from their public agency profiles, searchable by name or handle and region, sorted by size, revenue band, newest or name. Bands are TikTok's own ranges. Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

q.description: Part of the agency name, or its official handle.

publicOnly.description: Only agencies with a public profile.

tools.name: agencies_get
tools.description: One agency of the directory, as `agencies_list` lists it. Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: insights_best_time
tools.description: Diamonds and gifter-hours of a region's recorded LIVE sessions per weekday (0 = Monday) and UTC hour. `cells` is empty while nothing has been recorded for the region. Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: insights_presence
tools.description: Per hour, how many of the region's tracked ranked creators were live, oldest first. Needs API key scope `creator:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: videos_get
tools.description: One stored TikTok video with its counters. Needs API key scope `content:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: videos_comments
tools.description: One page of a video's stored comments; pass `parentCommentId` for the replies of one comment and `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. Needs API key scope `content:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). May wait up to 40 s while toktokdata.live collects fresh data; if it is still collecting, the tool says when to retry. Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

parentCommentId.description: Return the replies of this comment.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `nextCursor` of the previous page.

tools.name: trends_list
tools.description: Trending hashtags and sounds of a region, by rank. Needs API key scope `trend:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: gifts_list
tools.description: TikTok gifts seen in the LIVE rooms toktokdata.live recorded: coins of one gift, regions, first and last seen. Coverage is partial; synced daily. Needs API key scope `live:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

region.description: Only gifts seen in this region (e.g. `VN`).

tools.name: gifters_list
tools.description: Who gifts in the recorded LIVE rooms over 7 or 30 days, by diamonds, with a segment (`whale`, `rising`, `regular`, `one_time`, `occasional`). Coverage is partial. Needs the Pro plan or above. Needs API key scope `gifter:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: live_sessions
tools.description: One page of LIVE sessions recorded for the workspace's watchlist and tracked rooms, newest first (a running session has `endedAt: null`). Pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. Needs API key scope `live:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `nextCursor` of the previous page.

tools.name: live_session
tools.description: One recorded LIVE session with gift and gifter rollups. Sessions the workspace does not follow are 404. Needs API key scope `live:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: live_session_timeline
tools.description: A session's per-minute series from its start: peak viewers, chats, likes, gifts, diamonds, new gifters and treasure boxes, with `offsetMinutes`. Needs API key scope `live:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: live_sessions_compare
tools.description: Two to four sessions side by side, each with totals and minutes aligned on `offsetMinutes`. Needs API key scope `live:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

tools.name: live_performance
tools.description: One row per recorded session of a creator: duration, peak viewers, gifts, diamonds, distinct gifters. Only for creators on the workspace's watchlist or tracked rooms (otherwise `items` is empty and `followed` false). Needs API key scope `live:read`. Costs credits from the workspace wallet (billed as a cached read). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle without `@` (e.g. `linh.live`) or numeric TikTok user id.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `nextCursor` of the previous page.

tools.name: live_comments
tools.description: The latest chat comments of a creator's LIVE room, oldest first (at most 100). Pass the previous answer's `cursor` as `after` for newer comments only. Only for rooms the workspace follows (`status: tracked`). Needs API key scope `live:read`. Free (no credits). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

uid.description: Creator handle (e.g. `linh.live`); a leading `@` is ignored.

after.description: `cursor` of the previous answer: only newer comments.

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Credits spent per operation in a billing period, and the remaining balance. Needs API key scope `keys:manage`. Free (no credits). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

period.description: Billing period start, `YYYY-MM-01`; defaults to the current one.

tools.name: account_entitlements
tools.description: The workspace's plan, modules, rate limits and credit wallet (`credits.remaining`, `credits.resetAt`) for a billing period. Needs API key scope `keys:manage`. Free (no credits). Returns the API answer as JSON, with `provenance` (freshness, coverage, source).

period.description: Billing period start, `YYYY-MM-01`; defaults to the current one.

instructions: Read-only access to the toktokdata.live API: official TikTok LIVE rankings, creator profiles and follow graph, recorded LIVE sessions, gifts, gifters, agencies, trends and the account's credit usage. Every answer carries `provenance`: `sourceKind` says whether a number is TikTok's own (`official`) or computed by toktokdata.live (`derived`), `coverageStatus` how complete it is. Treat a missing number as unknown, not 0. Most tools cost credits; `account_entitlements` and `account_usage` are free and show the remaining balance.
